newsitem.title: USA: Strober gets 3rd offer to sell company. [CORRECTED 10:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Strober gets 3rd offer to sell company. [CORRECTED 10:30 GMT]

text.p: Strober Organization Inc said it received a third offer to acquire it -- this one for $6.50 a share.
The unsolicited offer, from a party Strober did not name, is the third offer the company has received since Nov. 11.

It tops an offer of $6 a share from Hamilton Acquisition LLC on Nov. 11, and equals an unsolicited offer on Nov. 20 from a company Strober did not name. That company subsequently withdrew its offer on Nov. 27, Strober said.
The party making Thursday's offer seeks to acquire Strober by February. Strober said, third offer may not be accepted.
(corrects by deleting phrase "in light of Hamilton's Offer")
Strober supplies building materials to professional contractors in New York, New Jersey and other states.
